title: Service Advisor - M. Create WO lines from Needs Attention inspection fields
preconds: Logged in as Service Advisor. WO = View/Create&Edit (no WO Delete) but WOL = V/E/D -> full inspection rights follow the LINE (SV-8095). A completed inspection has one or more fields flagged "Needs Attention".
steps:
1. Log in.
2. Open a completed inspection that has "Needs Attention" fields.
3. Choose to create work order line(s) from the Needs Attention field(s).
expected: Step 3: Allowed. Creating work order lines from "Needs Attention" inspection fields requires WOL Create and Edit. Service Advisor has it. (SV-8095 AC8; ties to SV-7815.)
